verdict.rationale: Amazon SES is a SaaS email service that processes customer email content, so a policy or control to stop that data being used for AI model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has nothing on AI-training opt-outs or data-use policies. KMS encryption of received mail and IAM access control are adjacent security features, not training-use controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
